title: On flowweb.app a button that only works on the Owner's Mac says so before it is pressed, instead of failing after
description: The hosted site (flowweb.app) is a mirror of fwd. Some writes there are queued to the Owner's Mac (draft changes, flow controls, hunts), but the rest answer 501 from api/v1.mjs because only fwd on the Mac can make them: the kill switch and its release, approving, denying or answering a card. Today those buttons look live on the site; the Owner presses one and only then reads 'fwd does not support this yet'. The kill switch is worse: holding Stop for 1.5 seconds ends in a refusal, and Settings on the site hides the kill switch entirely. The diff of an evidence bundle never leaves the Mac either, so the site asks for it, gets a 404 and offers a Retry that can never work. Add a macOnly prop to the Button in packages/web/src/ui-kit/Button.tsx: on the hosted site (HOSTED from packages/web/src/hosted/auth.ts) the button is disabled and its reason, 'Only on your Mac', is shown next to it and linked with aria-describedby; on the Mac it is an ordinary button. Use it for the kill switch (the big Stop everything button, Release and the release dialog), so the site never starts a hold or sends a stop, and the top-bar Stop only opens the kill switch dialog there. Settings on the site shows the kill switch too, locked the same way. The evidence view on the site says the diff is only on your Mac and does not request it. Approve, deny and answer on cards are table/CardView.tsx and are a separate change that uses this same prop. On the Mac nothing changes.
acceptance: On the site, a Button with macOnly is disabled and described by 'Only on your Mac'; pressing it does nothing
On the Mac, a Button with macOnly is an ordinary enabled button
On the site the kill switch's Stop everything is locked with that reason and holding the top-bar Stop never sends a stop
On the site, Release on a stopped kill switch is locked with that reason
Settings on the site shows the kill switch, locked with that reason
On the site the evidence view says the diff is only on your Mac and never requests it
On the Mac the kill switch still stops everything
